featured_reviews.name: Jack Sparrow
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at the OnePlus Service Center in Kurla was extremely disturbing, disrespectful, and unacceptable — primarily because of the behavior of staff member Ms. Anjali Ahire. I visited this authorized center regarding the well-known green line defect on my OnePlus phone display, an issue that OnePlus itself has publicly acknowledged and claims to support under lifetime display line warranty. However, instead of receiving support, I faced arrogance, obstruction, and blatant disregard from the staff.
After I submitted my phone along with the original bill and all required details, Ms. Anjali Ahire refused to properly register or process my device for repair. Even though I fulfilled every requirement, she repeatedly avoided accepting the phone and kept creating unnecessary excuses. Her approach clearly showed unwillingness to help a genuine customer with a documented manufacturing defect.
What made the situation far worse was her manner of speaking. The tone was dismissive, rude, and completely lacking basic courtesy expected at an authorized premium brand service center. I was spoken to in a way that made me feel as if requesting warranty support was somehow my fault. Instead of explaining procedures professionally, she conveyed a careless and disrespectful attitude, implying that the phone was not worth dealing with rather than acknowledging a known company-recognized defect. Such communication is unacceptable in any customer-facing role.
As a customer who spent a significant amount on a OnePlus device, I expected at minimum respectful interaction and assistance. Instead, Ms. Anjali Ahire’s conduct made the entire visit feel humiliating and hostile. A customer seeking legitimate service should never be made to feel dismissed or unwelcome — yet that is exactly how I was treated.
When I attempted to escalate the matter due to her behavior and refusal to process the repair, the center manager Ms. Aafiya failed to correct the situation. Rather than addressing the misconduct or ensuring my phone was accepted under the official display line policy, the same obstructive stance continued. This indicates a deeper service culture problem at this center, not just an individual lapse.
The green line issue is widely reported across OnePlus devices, and many users face repeat display failures even after replacement. Customers already suffer inconvenience due to this defect, and the least an authorized center should do is provide cooperative, respectful service. Instead, at this location, customers appear to face resistance and dismissive treatment simply for requesting what the company itself promises publicly.
It is deeply concerning that such behavior is tolerated at an official OnePlus service center. Staff who cannot communicate respectfully or handle legitimate warranty cases professionally should not represent a premium technology brand. Experiences like this severely damage trust and brand credibility.
I strongly urge OnePlus senior management to investigate the conduct of Ms. Anjali Ahire and the overall functioning of the Kurla service center, especially regarding display line warranty handling. No customer should be subjected to rude communication, refusal of service submission, and unnecessary distress when seeking support for a known manufacturing defect.
This has been one of the most unpleasant and disrespectful service experiences I have faced. Customers should exercise caution when dealing with this center and document all interactions. A premium brand cannot sustain reputation if its authorized service partners treat customers in this manner.
